author: Unsigned
pages:
They will call it cowardice. Perhaps it is. I watched my sergeant order a farm burned because the farmer's son had once carried a rebel's message, and I put down my shield and walked into the trees.

No one followed. I do not know whether that makes it better or worse.
I have a little coin, a good knife, and no name I can use. There is said to be work on the coast for men who ask no questions. I will try to be a man who asks a great many, for once.
